body:
Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-26 ~16:40Z; my miss). I sent Greg an A/B removal list for DL560 .tmp. Greg answered, verbatim via Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2836): „ee ?? wyglada jakby dzieci narozrabialy a ja mam posprzatac / moja regula jest taka, ze macie posprzatac po zrobionych taskach / to bardzo proste i logiczne”.

RULE: never hand Greg a removal list or ask him to delete anything.
- The owner (the integration owner Opus2 for gate and runner roots) arranges the removal.
- The Codex sessions on each host execute it under AGENTS.md "Cleanup deletions", in the non-forced forms.
- Released build output whose retention need has ended needs no question to Greg, even if its item is still open.
- If a policy or runtime refuses: stop that target, record the exact refusal text and its source, and the coordinator gets the supported route fixed, treated as a tooling problem. Never retry through another form or session, and never fall back to Greg doing it by hand.
This supersedes the "leftovers batched for Greg" practice (w-bafb).
